3129-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

262-2335-2433.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
262-2335-2433.notes: If Barrenton Medic starts with power 2 or greater, you'll make more tokens each loop and can place +1/+1 counters on other creatures after placing the first.

141-2034-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2906-4907-5686-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-4907-5686-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

232-1235-5940-6927.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

81-512-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
81-512-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

147-3505-6797.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

427-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-1978-5056.description:
Cause Kydele to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

5541-5571-5686--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2060-4050-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-4050-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

654-1231-2438-6644.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-5394-6291.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

238-5147-5756.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

152-4772-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-4772-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1170-2510-3363-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1170-2510-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-997-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

413-2060-2744-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
413-2060-2744-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1575-1651-4365-4659.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

307-2213-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Kappa Tech-Wrecker and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Kappa Tech-Wrecker or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}{U}.
307-2213-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Kappa Tech-Wrecker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Kappa Tech-Wrecker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Kappa Tech-Wrecker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Kappa Tech-Wrecker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1012-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

601-4552-5127.description:
Activate Mutavault's second ability by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, causing Mutavault to become a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Draconic Destiny by paying {1}{R}{R}, attaching it to Mutavault.
Activate Mutavault by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

2446-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites: Living Hive does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2446-3750-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Living Hive.
Living Hive triggers, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar at least five times by sacrificing at least five Insects, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

65-717-1076-2628-5181.description:
Activate Indatha Triome's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Indatha Triome from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Indatha Triome ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2781-4089.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore.
2781-4089.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Glasspool Mimic. Choose to have Glasspool Mimic enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-2744-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-2744-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
The Spirit tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1987-2427-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2427-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

2615-4752-5016.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-4752-5016.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Into the Maw of Hell for {4}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing thirteen damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
